note: Hand-typed from retrieved sources only. relation in {equivalent, related, not_equivalent}. system_a uses the K045 recorder proxy names (AS, UR, HP); system_b OKR = ascher_color_dc @ 4039ca5.

AS.basis: Ascher Databook II Table 5 (63 mnemonics with ISCC-NBS numbers) matches OKR ascher_color_dc by ISCC number; KFG Ascher_Import and ascher_color_count pages state Ascher's codes were encoded into the Harvard KDB by Carrie Brezine.

UR.basis: No Urton colour dictionary retrieved. Harvard KDP Data Tables page (archived 2011) says the tables 'mimic the layout of the tabular format first invented by the Aschers', and UR001's heading sheet prints an Ascher-style code ('Color: B-W'); OKR ascher_color_dc has PK = 'unknown Urton color'. This shows Urton records were stored in Ascher-style codes, not how Urton's field colours were chosen.

HP.basis: Pereyra's colour conventions (Pereyra 2006 / 2011 CONCYTEC books) not retrievable online; only OKR color_operator_dc row '%' = 'con elemento', NOTES "used in Hugo Peyera's descriptions".

sources.found: §5.8 'The majority of color schemes use the 65 “Brezine”/“Ascher” colors.' Operators: ': Mottled', '- Barberpole', '% Striped cord', '^ Tweed cord', '** Dahlsberg khipu cprd'
Brezine Color Chart: same 64 codes as OKR ascher_color_dc incl. 'PK-Unknown Urton Color'

§6 'Ascher Cord Colors have hundreds of typos and non-regular codes that need cleansing and normalizing'; bogus_mixed_color_types sample incl. '-':'PK', 'BY':'YB', 'W**BS':'W:BS'; mottled/barberpole components re-sorted by grey value (KFG normalisation, not applied to OKR snapshot)

KH0002-KH0010 import: 'I am trying to match Brezine colors to Ascher colors. I probably did a pretty bad job.'; sheet 4 'lists (some) Ascher colors for that khipu, that need translation into current-day Ascher colors' (AS001-AS009 only)
author counts incl. Gary Urton 239, Marcia & Robert Ascher 231, Hugo Pereyra 58; Urton khipus 'Repaired/Reconstructed'; no colour mapping
'Marcia Ascher invented a series of color codes ... encoded into the Harvard Khipu Database, by Carrie Brezine'
catalog metadata and bibliography; no colour-code dictionary (KH0586 cites Pereyra 2011; KH0469/KH0470 Urton 2017)

scanned Introduction to Databook II; p.18-19 'Color' (ISCC-NBS level 3, 'single or double letter mneumonics'; operators '-' barber pole, ':' mottled, '/' joined end to end; 'The color with the lower valued ISCC-NBS number is always listed first'); p.21 Table 5 mnemonic -> ISCC-NBS number
no colour-code or ingest documentation; repo tree @4039ca5 has no schema/codebook file besides khipu.db
'The database effectively and accurately contains color information by allowing many different color records for one cord.' No code list

descriptive_conflicts.a: OKR color_operator_dc: '%' = 'con elemento', NOTES "used in Hugo Peyera's descriptions"
descriptive_conflicts.reading: conflicting description of the % operator (affects HP strings)

descriptive_conflicts.a: Ascher Table 5: BY 79; OKR BY 'light grayish yellowish brown' ISCC 79 (YB is 76)
descriptive_conflicts.reading: KFG normalisation merges BY into YB; Ascher/OKR keep them distinct. OKR snapshot is unnormalised; K045 follows OKR/Ascher.

descriptive_conflicts.a: OKR ascher_color_dc PK = 'unknown Urton color' (ISCC 0); KFG Brezine chart 'PK-Unknown Urton Color'
descriptive_conflicts.b: KFG DatabaseSQLBuild '-' : 'PK' (a bare operator recoded as PK)
descriptive_conflicts.reading: PK is a placeholder for an unidentified colour, not a colour; it is in the dictionary (same_dictionary) but should never count as a colour match

descriptive_conflicts.a: Ascher Databook II p.19: lower ISCC-NBS number listed first in multicolour designations
descriptive_conflicts.b: KFG DatabaseSQLBuild: KFG re-sorts components by grey value
descriptive_conflicts.reading: component order of FULL_COLOR is a convention that can differ by source; a later test needs an order rule fixed in advance
